subject: Export fasta with two rows per individual

messages.author: be5831679f44e5dc
messages.subject: Export fasta with two rows per individual
parts:
Hi Guys,

I need to export fasta files with each individual represented by two rows, one with major alleles, and one with minor alleles. It needs to be nucleotides in order to use in the PopGenome R package, which only takes ATGCUN. Any suggestions?

The names would probably be "ind_name_1/2_pop.

Thanks,

Renee

messages.author: be5831679f44e5dc
messages.subject: Re: Export fasta with two rows per individual
parts: Ok, to solve this I used the gl2svdquartets function with method = 1, converted the nexus into individual population fasta files, and replaced all the "?" with "N". This all then goes in a folder that you can read into the PopGenome package.
